item: Show every firing of a watch in Insights > Watches (Lane M, R684)
summary: GET /api/watches/{id}/history had no button: the Watches list carries only the last 5 firings per watch. A watch showing 5 now offers Show every firing, which reads its whole history newest first (up to the route's 500, said so when cut) through one delegated listener, and keeps it across a language repaint without a second request. 4 strings in 12 languages. Feature ceiling down by 1.
